panel.evidence: The v1 list call (api/v1/documents.controller.ts:29-38) passes no `orderBy` at all, so the public API list order still diverges from the UI list's new `[{updatedAt desc},{createdAt desc}]`, while the raw Prisma row it returns now includes the new `updatedAt` column. docs/design/rest-api.md's Document schema (line ~61) documents only `createdAt`, so the API surface change is undocumented.
